name: Takara Sushi (Logan) "Protein Roll" in Soy Paper (Salmon, Albacore, Crab & Avocado)
whyItWorks: Takara's signature Protein Roll wraps crab meat, albacore tuna, salmon, shrimp tempura, and avocado in soft soy paper instead of fibrous seaweed nori.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Protein Roll in soy paper (ask for light or no tempura shrimp inside if avoiding fried items, and request eel sauce instead of spicy mayo).
watchOuts: Ask to hold spicy mayo or ponzu sauce if drizzled on top
